shard_of: last character of the bech32 address (terra1…x77ulw → w); non-terra → x

rules.replay_order: by height, then acquisition → return-from-custody → transfer → custody-entry → destruction (a wallet cannot move what it has not received), then msg_index
rules.custodian_moves: a wallet's transfer/stake into a registry custodian = state change (staked / staked_enterprise / staked:<role>), the custodian's transfer back = liquid, a custodian→custodian move re-labels the holder's state (role: holder)

note: every live ledger record naming this address as from or to (superseded rows excluded), + its positions replayed: holdings_now (state per token), held_past (closed positions with P&L two ways), counts. A position with acquired:null was opened by a custody move the ledger saw without the acquisition (pre-ledger) — labeled, never invented.
